text:
Zoe (Sales): FYI Orion's procurement pushed a hard ask: POC must ensure EU and APAC customers are processed only in their respective regions, KMS keys must never leave region, and they want a per-region sub-processor inventory and a simple one-paragraph attestation for the trial. Can we confirm feasibility + cost delta?

Ben (SE): We can do tenant-level geo-routing for the POC with tenant pinning. KMS: BYOK into the cloud KMS in-region or use our platform key scoped to the region. We will need to disable any central analytics exports for that tenant.

Client_Orion: Timeline: kickoff earliest Mon 2026-05-04. Also ask: will any background jobs (embeddings index, offline evals) touch data outside the pinned region? Need yes/no + mitigation.

Sana (Ops): For a short POC we can satisfy the request by: 1) creating tenant routing entries, 2) provisioning region-scoped keys or importing BYOK, 3) creating a customer-managed log sink in-region for control-plane audit logs, 4) disabling cross-region backups/analytics for that tenant. Estimated ops time 12-36 hours depending on BYOK/HSM import complexity.

Omar (Security): We'll need the sub-processor list by region and clarification on which fields Orion classifies as PII (they mentioned IPs and request headers). Draft attestation: "For the 30-day POC, Redwood will route tenant traffic and keep KMS keys and backups within the tenant's pinned region; no PII-bearing logs or backups will be exported off-region." Will adjust once infra confirms specifics.

Ben (SE): Answer on background jobs: default hosted pipelines may run centralized evals. For the POC we'll flip the tenant config to disable auto-exports and, if requested, run any necessary indexing on regional workers. That adds ~op-hours but doable.

Client_Orion: They need the API call to set pinning and a way to programmatically check effective region so their devs can validate behavior.

Ben (SE): API (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/orion/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"europe-west1","kms_key":"projects/orion/locations/europe-west1/keys/or-key-1"}'
```
Query effective region:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/orion/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
```
(we'll provide an SDK snippet in the quote)

Sana (Ops): Action items for ops: 1) post per-region sub-processor list (EU, APAC) by EOD, 2) confirm BYOK/HSM import lead time, 3) verify backup replication toggle behavior. I'll queue the tenant pin job once approvals are in.

infra-bot: Job queued: tenant-pin-2425550000. Approval required from infra + security.

Omar (Security): Note: if Orion requires that absolutely no sub-processor outside the region may process any metadata, that could be a blocker (some managed services replicate minimal metadata to our control plane). We'll surface that in the attestation.

Zoe (Sales): Pricing ask from Orion: please provide a compact POC quote with line items for setup, per-region key handling, and a possible surcharge for regional isolation work. They prefer under $2k for the short trial.

Ben (SE): Rough POC quote (internal):
- One-time setup (routing + log sink + config): $650
- BYOK/HSM import: $150 one-time (HSM escrow/validation may add $200)
- Key mgmt surcharge: $80/month per region (pro-rated for POC)
- Regional indexing workers (if needed): $120 for POC window
We can waive analytics isolation fee for POC but reserve the right to bill for extra reserved capacity.

Client_Orion: Please include a short note that control-plane audit logs can be delivered to our EU bucket for the trial. Also request the sub-processor list and the one-paragraph attestation to sign.

Sana (Ops): Confirmed: we can deliver audit logs to customer-controlled buckets in-region for the POC. Posting sub-processor summary (non-sensitive) here: cloud provider compute/networking, managed KMS service, metrics agent, log delivery job. Full list DM'd to legal.

Omar (Security): I'll prepare the attestation text once infra confirms the exact fields that may need redaction and we have the sub-processor list.

Zoe (Sales): I'll send Orion the quote, the API snippet, and request BYOK key material if they plan HSM import. Keeping timeline for Mon kickoff but dependent on approvals. :thumbsup:

Client_Orion: Thanks team. We'll await the attestation + sub-processor list by EOD tomorrow to confirm kickoff.
